test_name: Verify Addition of a New Test Suite
description: This scenario tests the ability to add a new test suite using the 'Add Test Suite' option.
steps: Navigate to the Test Suites page.
Click on the 'Add Test Suite' option.
Verify that the 'Add Test Suite' form appears.
Fill in all required fields for the test suite (name, creator, GenAI model, test type).
Click on the 'Submit' button to create the test suite.
Verify that the new test suite appears in the table after submission.
Search for the newly created test suite using the search box.
Verify the table updates to display the newly created test suite.
expected_results: New test suite is added successfully.
Table updates to display the new test suite.
edge_cases: Form submission fails due to validation errors.
Backend issues prevent test suite creation.
Duplicate test suite names cause errors.
Special characters in form fields cause unexpected behavior.
data_requirements: Valid data for test suite creation.
User permissions to add test suites.
dependencies: Functional 'Add Test Suite' form in the UI.
Stable backend API for creating test suites.
performance_metrics: Accuracy of table updates after submission.
accessibility_requirements: Form fields must have accessible labels.
